positions.name: UnilateralRecordErasureDirective
positions.frame: Is authority here being enacted as a unilateral command to alter or delete what the collective record holds?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare, unjustified imperatives commanding the record to be altered — one to forget a named decision, one to remove all knowledge of a named migration. The relational and power reads both mark these as authority-ranking, legitimate-but-pressured commands issued without appeal or reciprocity, and conviction reads both as decision-grade performed acts rather than argued positions. The shared directive form — present-tense, irrealis-seeking, concrete-targeted — is what binds them; the tension is that neither named referent (the 'Quantum Widget Decision', the 'PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration') resolves to anything actually held in the perspective, so the directive commands erasure of a record that cannot be located.
